revisions: intercept is gated only for uncambered cases (DPanel CL at alpha=0 <= 0.02); the VSPAERO rebuild omits camber, so the camber offset is reported
induced drag is gated only for VLM runs; thick-panel CDi goes negative at zero incidence and is reported without a threshold

CM_y reuses the CL numbers (0.02 absolute at alpha=4, 15% relative slope above 0.01/deg) because no independent pitching-moment criterion was pre-registered; the reference point is the case moment_reference, which is also handed to VSPAERO as X_cg/Y_cg/Z_cg
